Music discovery can reflect a listener’s expression, cultural context and feedback.

Persistent feedback lets recommendations adapt to individual experience.

Training: native classifier learns original / mirrored TRAIN features from the same network.
Inference: one image view, one pure FusDenseNet; no external encoder or probability mixture.

Paper core Figs1–4 and Eqs3–15: https://doi.org/10.1007/s41870-025-02531-y . Original/smoothed grayscale visible views substitute for unavailable IR. Three fusion-dense stages, four-head attention, dense/cross connections and mean/max/RMS/spatial pooling are retained; widths/depth are explicit project choices. The accepted classifier repair has the exact original pure backbone tensors. No new dense-block feature learning is claimed. TRAIN-only feature mean/std are folded algebraically into the classifier Linear layer. Inference is one network and one image view. Optional physiology/weather context is separate from facial benchmark evidence.

Future work and publication possibilities
Publication depends on sound data, rights and evaluation.
Collect diverse, consented disgust expressions and review labels. Confirm gains on a fresh identity-disjoint cohort with equal training budgets.
Current test accuracy 58.34% and disgust recall 46.84% remain modest. Improve native feature learning and validate pose, lighting and webcam robustness.
Resolve physiological source-dimension and timing issues, obtain adequate windows and validate on held-out people and stimulus identities.
A reproducibility or systems paper is plausible after these experiments. Clinical and patent claims require separate substantiation.

Next work needs diverse consented data, label review, fresh identity-disjoint testing and controlled equal-budget experiments. The accepted gain is native-classifier learning; it does not prove superior fused feature extraction. The baseline TRAINmirror-disgust failure was repaired on fitting examples, but reliable independent-camera/pose/lighting behavior remains unvalidated. Physiological timing/source integrity and sufficient participant/stimulus-held-out data remain open. A reproducibility/systems study may be feasible; no novelty, acceptance, patentability or clinical claim.
